title: What Is the Motor Top-2 Rate in Boat Race? Definition, Updates, and How It Differs from a Racer's Rate
description: The motor top-2 rate is a motor's share of top-2 finishes, cumulative from first use and set on the first day of each meet on the race card. A Toda 1R example compares racer and motor rates, explains Motor Condition columns, and shows Boat 1's 1st-place rates by motor and exhibition time rank, with FAQs.
